Emma C: Hey team — quick Q about holidays and PTO proration. I started on Mon 4/12 and the company-observed holiday is next week. Do I get holiday pay? Also my expense card hasn’t arrived yet, can I get reimbursed for relocation receipts in the meantime? :wave:
People Ops: Hi Emma — welcome! :tada: Generally holiday pay applies if you’re on payroll before the holiday date. I’ll confirm the cutoff with payroll. For the card: you can request a virtual card in Ramp or submit receipts for reimbursement. Link: https://app.ramp.com/cards (or email ops@redwood.com if urgent).
Alex W: Quick payroll note — holiday eligibility depends on payroll cutoff. If your hire was processed before cutoff you’ll be paid; otherwise it flows to next cycle. Can you DM me your new-hire ID and your start paperwork timestamp? PTO accrual: it starts day 1 but is prorated monthly — expect the prorated balance on your first paycheck.
Emma C: Thanks Alex — DMing now. For reimbursements, what's the fastest route? I have receipts from a relocation appointment this week.
Maria L: Submit a Concur expense and tag it "newhire-relocation". If you need funds before the next paycheck we can approve an off-cycle reimbursement — please include receipts and a short justification email to ops@redwood.com and cc your manager. Off-cycle typically takes ~3 business days after approvals.
Alex W: If you want the virtual card instead, Ramp can issue a virtual immediately once People Ops approves. I’ll cc finance on the DM so we can speed the virtual card + off-cycle approval if needed.
Jamal R: Welcome aboard Emma! FYI the team usually gets prorated PTO the first month; reach out if anything delays your equipment or cards and we’ll help patch you in.
People Ops: Checklist for Emma: 1) Enroll in benefits portal within 30 days (link in onboarding email) 2) Complete W-4 + direct deposit in payroll portal 3) Request virtual card in Ramp if physical card delayed. I’ll follow up in DM with the exact payroll cutoff dates so you know which cycle the holiday falls into.
Emma C: Perfect — thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick help :heart:
